algorithm: Enumerate each possible tick center, find its longest complete pair of arms, and mark every cell covered by a valid tick.
correctness_argument: Every tick marked by the algorithm paints only existing stars and meets the size bound. Any feasible drawing uses ticks contained in these maximal ticks, so every star must be covered by the union. Thus coverage is necessary and sufficient.
edge_cases: A tick of size exactly k
problem_understanding: A candidate center must be a star.

steps.claim: A candidate center must be a star.
steps.rationale: A candidate center must be a star.

steps.claim: A tick with arm length exactly k is invalid.
steps.rationale: A tick with arm length exactly k is invalid.

steps.claim: Every tick marked by the algorithm paints only existing stars and meets the size bound. Any feasible drawing uses ticks contained in these maximal ticks, so every star must be covered by the union. Thus coverage is necessary and sufficient.
steps.rationale: Every tick marked by the algorithm paints only existing stars and meets the size bound. Any feasible drawing uses ticks contained in these maximal ticks, so every star must be covered by the union. Thus coverage is necessary and sufficient.

steps.claim: Time: O(n m min(n,m)); space: O(n m).
steps.rationale: Time: O(n m min(n,m)); space: O(n m).

steps.claim: Implementation follows these obligations: A candidate center must be a star. Grow both upward diagonal arms together until either arm stops. A maximal tick of size at least k covers all its own smaller valid ticks. Mark the union of all valid ticks. Accept exactly when every star is covered.
steps.rationale: Implementation follows these obligations: A candidate center must be a star. Grow both upward diagonal arms together until either arm stops. A maximal tick of size at least k covers all its own smaller valid ticks. Mark the union of all valid ticks. Accept exactly when every star is covered.
